About Northgate Advisory

Northgate Advisory LLC was founded in New York in 2014 by two former plant managers who had spent a decade being consulted at. The firm has twelve consultants, every one of whom has run a plant, a supply chain or a P&L in manufacturing.

How we work

On site every week. A partner on every engagement. A written outcome agreed before we start, and a fee partly tied to it.

Leadership

  • Daniel Okoye, co-founder and managing partner
  • Sarah Lindqvist, co-founder and partner

Where we are

Northgate Advisory LLC, 245 Fifth Avenue, Suite 1200, New York, NY 10016, United States. We serve clients across the United States and Canada.

Credentials

Our partners are certified Lean Six Sigma Black Belts and members of the Association for Supply Chain Management.
